name: Josiah Rubio
bio: is a fourth year TAPS and CHDV major. Their UT credits include things too long to list, but notably Co-Directing The Tempest, Directing Pericles, Sound design, Scenic, Projections, and eventually they will  play-write a thesis... They would like to shout out all the people who have poured their amazing and beautiful work into this show, to make it the most gorgeous, gayest thing they have ever had the pleasure to put on stage. The painting they think relates best to their role on this show is "The Blue Room" by Suzanne Valadon.

name: Lena Wei
bio: is a second-year Economics & TAPS major. She has previously worked on As Y'all Like It and Pericles (assistant stage manager). The one painting that speaks to her role is Woman Holding a Balance by Johannes Vermeer (because it's about money, and that's what she does).

name: Charlie Carden
bio: is a second-year TAPS major (and maybe creative writing and history minor). This is his sixth UT show. They worked on Our Town (Assistant Stage Manager), The Burden of Burial (Scenic and Props Designer), Pericles (Assistant Stage Manager), This is as good as it gets (Assistant Stage Manager), and Sanctuary City (Assistant Scenic Designer). Outside of UT, his theater experience includes Mamma Mia (Stage Manager), Our Place (Stage Manager), Legally Blonde (Assistant Stage Manager), Keepers at the Edge of the Sea (Director), and The Legend of Sleepy Hollow (Stage Manager). He has loved working with this cast and crew and wants to thank them for an awesome first show as stage manager. The painting that speak to their role in the show is Man Writing by Candlelight by Hendrick ter Brugghen

name: Kaiden Wu
bio: likes building stuff. This may be the last set he creates before he transcends to the spirit realm (actually works on his thesis). He doesn't remember all the shows hes been on, but hes been with the Deansmen for a long while. The painting that speaks most to his role in the show is Christ Carrying the Cross (El Greco), because he had to carry big wood planks across campus.

name: Joshua Federman
bio: is a third-year Mathematics major and Chinese minor. His UT credits are We're Live (Ky), Pericles (Ensemble), and Arsenic and Old Lace (Officer Klein). A painting that speaks to his role on the show is The Sleeping Beauty by John Collier, because it represents how even in sleepiness, the drip is always top priority. The three figures sharing in both exhaustion and flyness represent him and his four incredible assistants, Elisa, Ari, Kaden, and Jasmine, who he cannot thank enough, and who not only bring more swagger to the world every day, but without whom none of this could have come together.

name: Lydia Gafford
bio: is a fourth year History and Art History double major. Her UChicago credits include the LVV Spring Showcase 2026 (lighting Designer), Pericles (lighting designer), El Cepillo de Dientes (lighting designer), The Burden of Burial Sophocles’ Antigone Reimagined (lighting designer), Our Town (lighting designer), the LVV Spring Showcase 2025 (lighting designer), 35mm (lighting designer), If/Then (lighting assistant), Maya Dance Winter Showcase 2025 (lighting programmer), Royal Flush (lighting designer), Oedipus (lightboard operator), and Maya Dance Winter Showcase 2024 (lighting designer). She is a lighting technician for the Logan Center and a researcher for the Craft Chronicle. A painting which speaks to her role in the show is Van Gogh's "Starry Night."

name: Brooklyn Myers
bio: is a fourth year Biology, History, and Gender and Sexuality Studies student. She has absolutely loved UT and is so happy she got back into theatre. She has done the enigmatic workshop We’re Live (Sound Design), Pericles (Sound Design), Arsenic and Old Lace (Asst Sound), along with designing for two T24s. The painting Making Music by Henriëtte Ronner-Knip describes my role in the show.

name: Yuna Yoshizawa
bio: is a first-year majoring in Biological Science and Neuroscience. This is her very first UT experience aside from messing around with the booth and playing the wrong music in high school musicals, and she had gained the most xp points at answering check-in questions that she doesn’t even understand. Though she initially signed up for musicals and pit orchestra rather than play, but who could ever blame several hours of ye old Willy Shaker with juicy romance?  Unfortunately she has little knowledge in art history, so the only painting she could find after a quick Google search is Work by Ford Magic Brown.

name: Ulyana Sharapova
bio: is a first year Astrophysics major. Her first show as UT was Sanctuary City (Assistant Stage Manager), and she’s excited for her second one! The painting she feels best represents her role in the show is An Alchemist and His Assistant by Frans Van Mieris I.

name: Connor Huard
bio: is a second-year Classics and Anthropology major who might minor in CEGU for some reason. Hamlet is her first UT production and she hopes you like it because otherwise, it might be her last! She is incredibly grateful to Josiah for letting her use her AP Art History knowledge for the first time in five years. The builders behind the Sagrada Familia speak to her role i’m the show as like them, she took way too long to finish what she built. A painting she would choose would be Cognoscenti in a Room hung with Pictures.

name: Kaden Kaden
bio: is a fourth-year History and Linguistics major. They have previously worked on Arsenic and Old Lace (Lighting Designer), Spelling Bee (Costume Designer), Cactus Flower (Associate Lighting Designer) Troilus and Cressida (Sound Designer), The Play That Goes Wrong (Lighting Designer); Strings Attached (Assistant Costume and Assistant Lighting Designer); Much Ado About Nothing (Assistant Scenic Designer); Arcadia & Happy Birthday Mars Rover (TAPS Pro-Shows) (Lighting Programmer and Board Operator); Muscle Memory (Lighting Designer); and ten Theater [24]s (Lighting/Sound Designer).

name: Jasmine Li
bio: is a fourth-year Anthropology and Linguistics major. She has previously worked on Sanctuary City (Stage Manager), Julius Caesar (Stage Manager), Red Rex (Assistant Stage Manager), As Y’all Like It (Stage Manager), Cactus Flower (Assistant Stage Manager), Troilus and Cressida (Assistant Stage Manager), Strings Attached (Assistant Production Manager), and Taming of the Shrew (Assistant Stage Manager). She is excited to be making her first (and probably only) foray into a non-management position with UT! She would pick Benjamin Long's Five Standing Men as her painting because she's still a bit disappointed the costumes team didn't have the hats to be able to make this painting their group picture.

name: Bryn Soven
bio: is a first-year aspiring Mathematics major. This is her first UT project, but she worked as a lighting and sound designer, and was involved in pit orchestra in high school. Her painting for this show is "The Sun" by Edvard Munch.

name: Theo Kurland
bio: is a first-year Political Science major. This is his first show with UT though he worked on some productions high school. He had a great time on Hamlet and can't wait for the next show! A painting that speaks to his role in the show is Café Terrace at Night by Van Gogh.

name: Thomas O’Maey
bio: is a second-year Physics and Math major. He has never worked on a UT production before but is looking forward to many to come. A painting that represents his role in the show is “Flaming June” by Sir Frederic Leighton, because it perfectly depicts how he looked after seven hours of Tech.
